sensor.py
“physical classroom”
Public MQTT broker
broker.hivemq.com
Web dashboard
“its twin”
“ventilate” / “stop” command, back through the broker
CO₂ · temperature · humidity, every 2 s
Python + paho-mqtt
public MQTT over secure WebSockets
mqtt.js + Chart.js
cost: €0
The return channel is what makes it a twin, not just a digital shadow.

05 · CHALLENGES & FUTURE DIRECTIONS
5/5
Key Bottlenecks
Compute & latency
Costly HPC · network delay
Cybersecurity
Anyone can inject “ventilate”
Interoperability
Vendor silos · validation
Human behaviour
People don’t follow equations
A hacked twin acts on the real world.
